key_features_and_flows.simple_registration: Runner identity using simple Name + Email (stored in localStorage / session or backend profile, no password requirement).
key_features_and_flows.event_creation_modal: Form to create new running training with: Title, Date & Time, Location, Pace/Difficulty, Distance (km), Max Capacity, Description.
key_features_and_flows.event_listing: Filterable list/grid of upcoming trainings (by distance, pace, location, search). Shows registered runners count vs capacity with progress ring/bar.
key_features_and_flows.runner_dashboard: Personal dashboard for runner showing: total attended trainings count, upcoming registered events, past attended events history, total kilometers run badge.
key_features_and_flows.join_leave_toggle: Instant One-Click Join / Leave training button with real-time capacity feedback and toast alerts.

design_elements.cards: Subtle border `#2A303C` on dark background `#16191E`, sharp to 8px rounded corners (`rounded-xl`), hover glow effect with border-orange-500/50.
design_elements.buttons: Pill or crisp 8px rounded (`rounded-lg`), bold uppercase font, solid orange primary CTA (`bg-[#FF5500] hover:bg-[#E04B00] text-white font-bold`), active state scaling `active:scale-95`.
design_elements.badges: Tactical style stats badge with dark background, bright border, and mono text (e.g. `10 KM`, `Pace: 5:15 min/km`, `3 / 15 bezcov`).
design_elements.navigation: Glassmorphic floating navbar with `backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0D0F12]/80 border-b border-[#2A303C]` z-50 stickiness.
design_elements.testing: All key interactive buttons, inputs, links, tabs, and counters MUST contain kebab-case data-testid attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: Language MUST be in Slovak (SK) e.g., 'Bežecké Tréningy', 'Vytvoriť tréning', 'Prihlásiť sa', 'Odhlásiť sa', 'Moja účasť', 'Môj profil', 'Počet absolvovaných tréningov'.
Use Lucide-react icons for sport stats (MapPin, Calendar, Clock, Flame, Users, Trophy, Award, CheckCircle, Plus, Search, Filter, Runner/Activity).
Ensure all interactive components have proper data-testid attributes e.g., data-testid='create-event-button', data-testid='runner-email-input', data-testid='join-event-btn-1'.
Use Sonner for toast notifications when a user registers, creates an event, or leaves an event.
Simple identity modal / runner switcher: Allow user to input or switch name/email easily to view their personalized dashboard and attendance records.
